blockers.detail: No container header (ELF/Mach-O/PE) found, so no load address, entry point or memory map can be discovered from the file bytes. REA's raw-binary increment documents that it does not guess these.

notes: No container magic and no vector-table evidence; the file looks like an opaque blob.
recommended: Supply --entry-point / load address yourself, or extract a container; REA documents that it will not guess them.
